_readme: Reference cases. The expected values come from Onur, from a recognised program;
they are not calculated by this app. As long as a value is null the test is a todo.
Units: h, c, d_v in m; a_s in cm2/m; f in N/mm2; d_max in mm; n, v in kN/m, m in kNm/m.
n: compression positive (sign as used for the check, not as in a Plaxis file).
m > 0: tension side 'p' (a_sp, c_p); m < 0: tension side 'n' (a_sn, c_n).
d_vp / d_vn: null means d = h - c.
m_rd: signed like the commercial program, negative for m < 0 (tension side n); [kNm/m].

SIA m_rd (2026-10-24): commercial program, general interaction diagram, N constant, concrete diagram type 2, eps_cu 3.5 per mille, eps_su 12 per mille. eps_v, k_d, v_rd, utilization (2026-10-24): hand calculation Onur, Excel SIA262_Querkraft_Kontrolle, with m_Rd from the commercial program.
